SELECT ri.id, DATE(ri.time) as time,
CASE WHEN ri.type = 'buy' THEN '采购单' WHEN ri.type = 'sell' THEN '销售单' WHEN ri.type = 'bre' THEN '采购退货单' WHEN ri.type = 'sre' THEN '销售退货单' WHEN ri.type = 'swap' AND ri.direction = 0 THEN '调拨单-出' WHEN ri.type = 'swap' AND ri.direction = 1 THEN '调拨单-入' WHEN ri.type = 'entry' THEN '其它入库单' WHEN ri.type = 'extry' THEN '其它出库单' ELSE ri.type END as type, ri.direction, ri.nums,
CASE WHEN ri.type = 'buy' THEN b.id WHEN ri.type = 'sell' THEN s.id WHEN ri.type = 'bre' THEN br.id WHEN ri.type = 'sre' THEN sr.id WHEN ri.type = 'swap' THEN sw.id WHEN ri.type = 'entry' THEN e.id WHEN ri.type = 'extry' THEN ex.id ELSE NULL END as "costData.id", CASE WHEN ri.type = 'buy' THEN b.number WHEN ri.type = 'sell' THEN s.number WHEN ri.type = 'bre' THEN br.number WHEN ri.type = 'sre' THEN sr.number WHEN ri.type = 'swap' THEN sw.number WHEN ri.type = 'entry' THEN e.number WHEN ri.type = 'extry' THEN ex.number ELSE NULL END as "costData.number",
CASE WHEN ri.type = 'buy' THEN f_b.name WHEN ri.type = 'sell' THEN f_s.name WHEN ri.type = 'bre' THEN f_br.name WHEN ri.type = 'sre' THEN f_sr.name WHEN ri.type = 'swap' THEN f_sw.name WHEN ri.type = 'entry' THEN f_e.name WHEN ri.type = 'extry' THEN f_ex.name ELSE NULL END as "costData.frameData.name"
FROM room_info ri INNER JOIN room r ON ri.pid = r.id
LEFT JOIN buy b ON ri.type = 'buy' AND ri.class = b.id LEFT JOIN frame f_b ON b.frame = f_b.id
LEFT JOIN sell s ON ri.type = 'sell' AND ri.class = s.id LEFT JOIN frame f_s ON s.frame = f_s.id
LEFT JOIN bre br ON ri.type = 'bre' AND ri.class = br.id LEFT JOIN frame f_br ON br.frame = f_br.id
LEFT JOIN sre sr ON ri.type = 'sre' AND ri.class = sr.id LEFT JOIN frame f_sr ON sr.frame = f_sr.id
LEFT JOIN swap sw ON ri.type = 'swap' AND ri.class = sw.id LEFT JOIN frame f_sw ON sw.frame = f_sw.id
LEFT JOIN entry e ON ri.type = 'entry' AND ri.class = e.id LEFT JOIN frame f_e ON e.frame = f_e.id
LEFT JOIN extry ex ON ri.type = 'extry' AND ri.class = ex.id LEFT JOIN frame f_ex ON ex.frame = f_ex.id
AND r.goods = #{query.goodsId}
AND r.attr = #{query.attrId}
AND (
ri.type = 'buy' ri.type = 'sell' ri.type = 'bre' ri.type = 'sre' (ri.type = 'swap' AND ri.direction = 0) (ri.type = 'swap' AND ri.direction = 1) ri.type = 'entry' ri.type = 'extry' 1=0
)
AND (
OR (ri.type = 'buy' AND b.number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.documentNumber}, '%'))
OR (ri.type = 'sell' AND s.number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.documentNumber}, '%'))
OR (ri.type = 'bre' AND br.number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.documentNumber}, '%'))
OR (ri.type = 'sre' AND sr.number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.documentNumber}, '%'))
OR (ri.type = 'swap' AND sw.number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.documentNumber}, '%'))
OR (ri.type = 'entry' AND e.number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.documentNumber}, '%'))
OR (ri.type = 'extry' AND ex.number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.documentNumber}, '%'))
)
AND DATE(ri.time) >= #{query.startDate}
AND DATE(ri.time) <= #{query.endDate}
ORDER BY ri.time DESC

SELECT ri.time AS time,
CASE WHEN ri.type = 'buy' THEN '采购单' WHEN ri.type = 'sell' THEN '销售单' WHEN ri.type = 'bre' THEN '采购退货单' WHEN ri.type = 'sre' THEN '销售退货单' WHEN ri.type = 'swap' THEN '调拨单' WHEN ri.type = 'swapEnter' THEN '调拨单-入' WHEN ri.type = 'swapOut' THEN '调拨单-出' WHEN ri.type = 'entry' THEN '其它入库单' WHEN ri.type = 'extry' THEN '其它出库单' ELSE ri.type END AS type,
CASE WHEN ri.type = 'entry' THEN (SELECT number FROM is_entry WHERE id = ri.class) WHEN ri.type = 'extry' THEN (SELECT number FROM is_extry WHERE id = ri.class) WHEN ri.type = 'buy' THEN (SELECT number FROM is_buy WHERE id = ri.class) WHEN ri.type = 'sell' THEN (SELECT number FROM is_sell WHERE id = ri.class) WHEN ri.type = 'bre' THEN (SELECT number FROM is_bre WHERE id = ri.class) WHEN ri.type = 'sre' THEN (SELECT number FROM is_sre WHERE id = ri.class) WHEN ri.type = 'swap' OR ri.type = 'swapEnter' OR ri.type = 'swapOut' THEN (SELECT number FROM is_swap WHERE id = ri.class) END AS number, CAST(ri.direction AS SIGNED INTEGER) AS direction, CAST(ri.nums AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS nums FROM is_room_info ri INNER JOIN is_room r ON ri.pid = r.id WHERE r.goods = #{id} ORDER BY ri.time DESC
